entries.title: Observational distance

inputs.purpose: State what the camera may observe without intervening.

entries.outputIntent: A restrained camera plan that lets blocking and duration carry the scene.
guidance: Choose a stable vantage with meaningful foreground, middle ground, and exits.
Move only when a change in knowledge, power, or access earns the move.
Keep lighting motivated by the location and preserve its direction across coverage.
verifyCriteria: Every camera move corresponds to a story-state change.
Coverage preserves the scene's spatial relationships.
incompatibilities: Decorative movement without a narrative trigger
Coverage that repeatedly crosses the established axis

entries.title: Subjective pressure

inputs.purpose: Identify whose pressure or uncertainty organizes the image.
Identify the visible or implied force closing in on that viewpoint.

entries.outputIntent: A point-of-view-led camera and light package that increases psychological pressure without losing legibility.
guidance: Use controlled proximity, occlusion, or constrained headroom to bind the frame to the chosen viewpoint.
Let movement expose or deny information instead of merely adding instability.
Shape contrast around the pressure source while retaining enough environmental evidence to orient the viewer.
verifyCriteria: The dominant viewpoint is identifiable from framing and information access.
Pressure grows through a measurable change in space, information, or light.
incompatibilities: Total spatial ambiguity that prevents the threat relationship from reading

entries.title: Geometric control

inputs.purpose: Define the symmetry, repetition, or alignment that expresses control.

entries.outputIntent: A precise formal system in which deviations from visual order carry meaning.
guidance: Establish a repeatable axis, horizon, and spacing system before breaking it.
Treat a framing deviation as an event tied to story or character change.
Use lighting zones to reinforce the composition rather than flattening its planes.
verifyCriteria: The baseline geometry can be stated and repeated.
Every major deviation has a narrative purpose.
incompatibilities: Arbitrary reframing that weakens the formal baseline

entries.title: Kinetic clarity

inputs.purpose: Declare the subject path and dominant screen direction.
Name what the viewer must track during the move.

entries.outputIntent: A dynamic camera plan that preserves geography and the action's information priority.
guidance: Select a movement relationship to the subject before selecting ornamental camera motion.
Protect the dominant screen direction until an intentional reset establishes a new axis.
Reserve the strongest acceleration or scale change for the decisive beat.
verifyCriteria: The subject path and camera path are independently describable.
The decisive beat remains readable at the movement peak.
incompatibilities: Competing subject and camera motion without a tracking priority
Axis changes without a visible reset

entries.title: Soft naturalism

inputs.purpose: Identify the plausible source that motivates exposure and direction.

entries.outputIntent: An intimate image system whose softness remains directional and continuous.
guidance: Anchor soft light to a plausible window, sky, fixture, or reflected source.
Use gentle contrast and restrained camera proximity without erasing facial or spatial structure.
Carry source direction and ambient color relationships through coverage.
verifyCriteria: The dominant light direction remains identifiable.
Softness does not remove the separation needed to read face, action, and space.

provenance.adaptation: Named-person imitations were removed. Rewritten as generic, composable camera and lighting strategies with explicit verification.
